name: B10-0083/2026 (ECR) – Brutal repression against protesters in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the brutal repression against protesters in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Iran's violent crackdown on protests that began in late December 2025, which it says has killed at least 2,550 people. It asks Iran to stop the killings, restore internet access, allow peaceful protests and release people jailed for exercising basic rights. It also asks European Union countries to impose new sanctions on named Iranian leaders, label Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps as a terrorist organisation, and consider closing their embassies in Iran.

- What changes: nothing yet; it is the Parliament's opinion and a set of requests.
- Who it affects: Iran's leaders and security forces, protesters, and European Union governments.
- What happens next: European Union governments decide whether to impose sanctions and close embassies.
